use: Visual reference and candidate asset inventory for C6.2. These sheets show the established MealUp Toy Food Object/Kitchen Object visual language.
important_distinction: The sheets are reference/catalog images, not automatically individual transparent production assets. Individual assets must still be extracted/generated, reviewed, and registered with their own binary PNG plus metadata.
png_answer: Saving/uploading the source as PNG is useful, especially when an individual object has transparency. However, PNG alone does not make the whole catalog a set of registered assets: individual object files are still required.
current_operational_effect: The previously assumed 'no usable visual source' blocker is removed. The catalog can now be used to audit existing visual coverage and to drive consistent extraction/generation of individual C6.2 assets.
